guide.summary: A sugar eater that makes its surroundings sour and likes them that way.
guide.biology: Some bacteria make acids as they feed, and many of them grow best in sour places where other microbes slow down.
guide.rules: Lives in water and gel. Eats sugar using oxygen and releases 0.40 acid for each unit of carbon it eats, lowering the local pH. Moves 0.25 cells per second and senses food up to 2 cells away. Grows best at pH 4.5 to 6; it weakens above pH 6 and cannot feed at pH 7 or higher, so it needs a sour start. Rampart's rivalry chemical harms it.
guide.example: Add acidifier to a sugar patch before adding Sourbuds, then watch them keep the patch sour as they feed.
